value.description: Exclusion rule: attic area meeting 10.5.40.40(1) that is used for mechanical equipment is excluded from GFA if it is no more than 5% of the permitted maximum GFA, up to 20 m2.
value.gaps: Depends on attic use and geometry. M-229 (operator 2026-10-20, amends M-171): applied by default in the maximum design where the counted attic passes 10.5.40.40(1): min(5 % × permitted maximum GFA, 20 m²) is left out of GFA as mechanical-equipment space (a design choice taken as met, M-172(3); as M-210 for suites), disclosed achieved-if mechanical_attic_excluded; the scenario step applies it (Spec 78 P5.13; the M-472 rows). Layer 1 answers the two clause literals (mechanical_attic_share_pct 5 pct, mechanical_attic_area_max_m2 20 m2; Q-M1 b+ 2026-11-04); they are stored in Layer 2 on the increment-3 night, and until then the M-472 rows that read them answer not_evaluated:missing_input:absent_target (mechanical area: not yet stored). Whether an attic passes, and its floor area, is Layer 3 geometry.
